title: 第一卷 第19章 若雪归来第一卷 第20章 娶妻之争
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: “如玉，我给你想了一条绝佳的赚钱路子！”
林逸看着容颜绝美，妩媚动人的颜如玉，笑着说道。
“夫君，什么路子？”
“我可不像婉儿妹妹那样，有酿酒天赋！”
颜如玉秀眉微蹙，好奇问道。
“你在牙行做牙婆，很擅长与人打交道，做生意是一把好手！”
“不若我将你送到醉仙坊，做卖酒的酒娘！”
林逸灿然一笑。
“夫君，我如今已是踏上仙路了，品灵酒对我来说，不是问题！”
“我在牙行十年，见过形形色色的人。卖酒也好，说媒也罢，说到底都是和人打交道，我能行！”
颜如玉闻言，眼前一亮，满脸自信道。
林逸看着她，心里涌起一股暖意。
醉仙坊内，酒香扑鼻。
“哟，老林头来了，这位是？”
曲嫣然正在柜台后算账，看见林逸带着一个绝美女子进来，忙笑着迎上来。
“内人颜如玉，前几天刚娶的！”
林逸嘿嘿一笑，介绍道。
“曲坊主好！”
颜如玉盈盈一笑，不卑不亢，行礼道。
“老林头，你这也太能干了！”
“又娶了一个妻子，模样真是绝美，身姿更是曼妙！”
曲嫣然打量颜如玉一眼，眼里闪过惊艳，赞叹不已。
满脸皱纹的年迈老头，娶的妻子，个个都是年轻貌美，娇滴滴，惹人怜爱。
着实令人艳羡。
“曲坊主，我这妻子颜如玉，之前在凡人牙行做牙婆，很会与人打交道！”
“她在牙行十年，自己攒了十块下品灵石的私房钱，现在踏上了仙路，我想让她来醉仙坊做个酒娘，帮忙卖酒，你看如何？”
林逸嘿嘿一笑，恳切问道。
“如玉姑娘，你虽然踏上了仙路，但毕竟是刚入门，灵酒的品类、年份、功效，你都了解吗？客人问起来，你能答得上来？”
曲嫣然看着颜如玉，淡淡笑道。
颜如玉没有急着回答。
她看了一眼柜台上的酒坛，又看了一眼店里正在挑选灵酒的几个顾客。
“曲坊主，灵酒的知识，我可以学！”
“但有一件事，我在牙行十年，比谁都清楚，来买酒的客人，和来买媳妇的修仙者，本质上没什么两样！”
“有人是为了面子，有人是为了实惠，有人是为了送礼做人情。我能一眼看出，他兜里有多少灵石，舍得花多少！”
颜如玉声音不疾不徐道。
“你倒说说，怎么让人多买一坛？”
曲嫣然被勾起兴趣。
恰好有顾客进店，是个四十来岁的中年修者，炼气四层，一身青袍洗得发白。
“掌柜的，来一坛普通灵酒！”
content_en:
"Ruyu, I have thought of an excellent way for you to make money!"
Lin Yi looked at the beautiful and charming Yan Ruyu and said with a smile.
"Husband, what's the way?"
"I'm not as gifted in winemaking as sister Wan'er!"
Yan Ruyu frowned slightly and asked curiously.
"You work as a nanny in a dental shop, you are very good at dealing with people, and you are a good hand in business!"
"How about I send you to Zuixianfang to be a wine girl selling wine!"
Lin Yi smiled brightly.
"Husband, I have now embarked on the path of immortality. Drinking spiritual wine is not a problem for me!"
"I've been working in Yahang for ten years and I've met all kinds of people. Whether it's selling wine or doing matchmaking, in the end it's all about dealing with people. I can do it!"
When Yan Ruyu heard this, her eyes lit up and she said with confidence.
Lin Yi looked at her, feeling warm in his heart.
In Zuixianfang, the aroma of wine is fragrant.
"Hey, Lao Lintou is here, who is this?"
Qu Yanran was settling accounts behind the counter when she saw Lin Yi coming in with a beautiful woman and greeted her with a smile.
"My wife, Yan Ruyu, just got married a few days ago!"
Lin Yi smiled and introduced.
"Hello, Master Qufang!"
Yan Ruyu smiled, neither humble nor arrogant, and said politely.
"Old Lintou, you are so capable!"
"I have married another wife. She looks absolutely beautiful, and her figure is even more graceful!"
Qu Yanran looked at Yan Ruyu, her eyes flashed with surprise and admiration.
An old man with wrinkles on his face married wives who were all young, beautiful, delicate and lovable.
It's really enviable.
"Master Qufang, my wife Yan Ruyu used to be a nanny at Mortal Tooth Shop, and she is very good at dealing with people!"
"She has been in Yaxing for ten years. She has saved ten yuan of low-grade spiritual stones for her own money. Now she has embarked on the path of immortality. I want her to come to Zuixianfang to be a wine girl and help sell wine. What do you think?"
Lin Yi chuckled and asked sincerely.
"Miss Ruyu, although you have embarked on the path of immortality, you are still just getting started. Do you know the category, age, and efficacy of spiritual wine? Can you answer the customer's question?"
Qu Yanran looked at Yan Ruyu and smiled lightly.
Yan Ruyu didn't answer in a hurry.
She glanced at the wine jar on the counter, and then at the few customers in the store who were selecting spirits.
"Master Qufang, I can learn the knowledge of spiritual wine!"
"But there is one thing. I have been in Yaxing for ten years, and I know better than anyone else that there is essentially no difference between a customer who comes to buy wine and a cultivator who comes to buy a wife!"
"Some do it for face, some do it for benefits, and some do it for giving gifts as a favor. I can tell at a glance how many spiritual stones he has in his pocket and how much he is willing to spend!"
Yan Ruyu's voice was calm and slow.
"Tell me, why do people buy more jars?"
Qu Yanran's interest was aroused.
A customer happened to come into the store. He was a middle-aged cultivator in his forties, with a fourth level of Qi refining, and a green robe that had been washed white.
"Shopkeeper, bring me a jar of ordinary spirit wine!"
